segments.name: Residential Cabinets
segments.description: Manufactures residential cabinetry, sold in the United States and Canada to remodeling and new construction customers through dealers, retailers and builders.
segments.evidence: We are the largest manufacturer of residential cabinets in North America, based on 2024 reported net sales.

revenueModel.text: Dealers, retailers and builders pay for residential cabinets and cabinetry that the company manufactures and sells for remodeling and new construction.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold primarily throughout the United States and Canada to the remodeling and new construction markets through three primary channels: Dealers, Retailers and Builders.

changes.text: In 2024 the company acquired Supreme, a domestic maker of residential cabinetry with brands focused on premium products.
changes.evidence: On July 10, 2024, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding limited liability interests of Dura Investment Holdings LLC, the parent company of Supreme Cabinetry Brands, Inc. ("Supreme"), a cabinetry company.

changes.text: In 2025 the company announced an agreement to combine with American Woodmark, a transaction expected to close in early 2026.
changes.evidence: On August 6, 2025, we announced the execution of a definitive agreement whereby the Company will combine with American Woodmark Corporation ("American Woodmark"), a Virginia corporation, in an all-stock transaction.
